title: Binance Will List Acala (ACA)
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance will list  Acala (ACA)  at 2022-01-25 12:00 (UTC). Binance will open trading pairs for  ACA/BTC ,  ACA/BUSD , and  ACA/USDT . Users can start depositing  ACA  in preparation for trading from 2022-01-25 06:00 (UTC) Withdrawals for ACA will open at 2022-01-26 12:00 (UTC) Users who participated in the Polkadot Parachain Slot Auctions and voted for ACA via Binance can  claim their rewards  starting from 2022-01-25 06:00 (UTC) Note: Transfers of the ACA token on the Acala mainnet will begin one hour after  block height 265,280 , at approximately 2022-01-25 06:00 (UTC) The withdrawal open time is an estimated time for users’ reference. Users can view the actual status on the withdrawal page What is Acala (ACA)? Acala network is an EVM-compatible DeFi smart contract platform which operates as a Polkadot parachain. ACA is the native token of the platform, which can be used to mint stablecoins, pay transaction fees, participate in governance, earn rewards through staking and liquidity mining. ACA Listing Fee: 0 BNB. Details: ACA Website ACA Block Explorer Fees Rules Risk warning : Cryptocurrency trading is subject to high market risk. Please make your trades cautiously.
